questions.prompt: How did the squirrels get across the lake to Owl Island?
questions.evidence: They made little rafts out of twigs, and they paddled away over the water to Owl Island

questions.prompt: What did Old Brown do when Nutkin sang his first riddle?
choices: He shut his eyes and went to sleep
questions.evidence: He shut his eyes obstinately and went to sleep.

questions.prompt: On the third day, the other squirrels each brought a fat minnow. What did Nutkin bring?
choices: A fat minnow, like the others
questions.evidence: but Nutkin, who had no nice manners, brought no present at all

questions.prompt: What did Old Brown do with the honey?
choices: He threw it in the lake
questions.evidence: But he ate up the honey!

questions.prompt: What did Nutkin do right before Old Brown caught him?
choices: He jumped onto Old Brown's head
He gave Old Brown an egg
He said sorry to Old Brown
questions.evidence: he took a running jump right onto the head of Old Brown

questions.prompt: How did Nutkin get away from Old Brown?
choices: He pulled so hard his tail broke
questions.evidence: Nutkin pulled so very hard that his tail broke in two, and he dashed up the staircase and escaped out of the attic window

theme.prompt: Every day the other squirrels were polite to Old Brown, but Nutkin teased him again and again. What does the story show?
choices: Teasing someone again and again can get you into big trouble
Old Brown liked riddles more than presents
Being rude is fine if you sing it
evidence: But Nutkin was excessively impertinent in his manners
Nutkin became more and more impertinent
But Nutkin was in his waistcoat pocket!

segments.written: Nutkin kept teasing Old Brown, and Old Brown didn't like it. How does it feel when someone keeps teasing you? What could you do?
